Name: Erek King (Replacement for Linus)
Author: cynicalbroad
Description:
[u][i][b]What's Included:[/b][/i][/u]
Replaces Linus' name, portrait, sprites, dialogue, festival dialogue, event dialogue, and (some) dialogue other villagers have about Linus.
NOTE: When upset Erek's portrait and sprite will "glitch", referencing is holographic nature in [i]Animorphs[/i]. This is entirely normal and is what he is intended to do, don't worry, your game isn't corrupted. Lol

Tell me if you see anyone talking about Linus and not Erek and I'll update with a dialogue patch. ;0
[u]
[b][i]Other mods pictured (but not at all required for my mod):[/i][/b][/u][list]
[*][i]Lavender's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1573/]A Toned Down Stardew Valley[/url]﻿ (which uses assets from Eemie's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2050?tab=logs]Just A New Map Recolor[/url]﻿)
[/i]
[*][i]Mana's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1244?]Vintage Interface Mod[/url]﻿
[/i]
[/list]
More about Erek King [url=http://animorphs.wikia.com/wiki/Erek_King]here[/url].

Anticipate another version of this mod which replaces Leah instead. And potentially an update to this one with more dialogue since he's pretty bare bones atm.

Downloads.Description: The complete package. Simply drag and drop the folders into your Content folder and allow the files to overwrite. c: I recommend backing up your Characters and Data folders before downloading this mod though.
